author: Tarheelkiwi
body:
Hey guys, today I found another hacker in Nexus. 

IGN:Yukinushi
Hack: kill arura

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X0LJ4FS0iK8&feature=autoshare

The real money is at the end.  He was able to kill another player from an insane distance.  He must of had his kill radius huge.  I have problems with this player before.  I have reported him, but there weren't any staff members that showed up.  I believe he is hacking, but I want you guys to let me know if he is indeed hacking.
